priority_rule: Actual accuracy and total repeated-process cost precede automatic dispatch. Preserve the strongest applicable comparator and all failures.

items.implementation: Run exact clean source/build preflight, smoke, standard, separate accuracy probes, stage scaling and matched external comparisons using local scripts. Include all four conditional kernel examples in a separate campaign, never in whole-ODE latency ranks.
items.acceptance: Same work/output/error semantics; independent process repeats; source/build/binary linkage; retain missing references, failures, unavailable profilers and unexecuted rows.

items.implementation: Extend immutable invariant-module plan with sparse/banded/declared structured B and outward action/error bounds; keep a fresh original-target residual and cached dissipativity proof.
items.acceptance: Demonstrate total benefit against reused LU and structure-specific direct formula including admission; poison callbacks, malformed dimensions, epoch drift and nonnormal counterexamples fail closed.

items.target: independent references for remaining 17 suite models
items.implementation: Add independently derived solutions or cross-checked high-accuracy VODE/DVODE, diffsol or Julia references to the exact registered model variants; include spatial grid refinement for PDE claims.
items.acceptance: Reference error estimate smaller than tested accuracy, synchronized output times, no final-time phase aliasing; failed reference builds remain visible.

items.implementation: Enumerate a bounded set of structurally supplied charts; select using denominator separation, certified defect, admitted norm growth and measured total cost; retain original-coordinate fallback.
items.acceptance: Near-pole/rounded denominator cases never falsely imply original singularity; setup and unsuccessful chart costs charged; retain Jordan multiplicity and direct-oracle tests.

items.implementation: Construct validated domains for a genuinely coupled nonlinear target; add conservative patch subdivision and a matched existing corrector comparison without silently adding JVP/Newton to the fixed-P route.
items.acceptance: Same target and root branch with whole-domain bounds; tolerance floors, fold boundaries and evaluation errors retained; compare total provider/patch setup plus solve cost.

items.implementation: Use measured provider costs and local reference guard receipts to choose cadence and guards for host-specific expensive RHS regimes.
items.acceptance: Beat fixed causal and strongest protected comparator at equal accuracy across nonlinear regime changes; no global overhead claim without stationary/acceptance/cap assumptions.

items.implementation: Follow analysis/N8_DISCRIMINATION_COVERAGE.json; execute each retained family experiment only after its structural/reference prerequisites exist.
items.acceptance: Do not replace pending experiments with policy labels; retain earlier validated evidence and add only changed-scope checks.

items.target: true ignition and nonlinear spherical dynamics variants
items.implementation: Add separately named physically specified ignition and nonlinear sphere shallow-water variants with independent references, conserving the original attachment negative controls.
items.acceptance: Model identity, boundaries, parameters and exact/independent reference stated; do not relabel the current nonigniting scalar or linearized harmonic waves.

items.implementation: Port the bounded exact offline prototype into a small reusable Rust planning workspace only for verified stage sensitivity and contraction providers; incorporate error floors and h-dependent physical budgets.
items.acceptance: Compare total setup plus solve cost, preserve original-target residual and global-order sufficient conditions, retain strongest direct methods and fail closed when bounds or domain change.
